author: James Teit (ed. Franz Boas)
notes: The file is the whole Jesup vol. I (1898-1900, ~225k words, with index); Teit's monograph runs from about character 466,000 to 1,060,000 of the file (running head 'THE THOMPSON INDIANS OF BRITISH COLUMBIA'), roughly 100k words, complete. OCR readable apart from noisy cover pages. Other parts of the volume (Smith archaeology, Boas facial paintings, Farrand basketry) are not part of the ethnography.
